title: Official blog AI review handoff stage 20
summary: This iteration adds an internal AI review handoff for the official-blog workflow. The handoff turns a review packet or review-session output into preview-safe AI instructions and a blank decision template, while preserving the separate AI decisions file, manual review, authoring, dry-run, and curated-record write checkpoints.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "official blog AI review handoff|official blog review-handoff" tests/official-blog-knowledge.test.js tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: The AI review step needs a copy-safe handoff artifact, not manual prompt assembly from a review packet.
lessons.evidence: Stage 20 adds `official_blog_ai_review_handoff` with prompt instructions, embedded review packet, and blank decision templates keyed by `intake_id`.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the handoff artifact as the stable boundary between preview review packet creation and separate AI decision capture.

lessons.lesson: A prompt handoff must not become an implicit decision normalizer.
lessons.evidence: Stage 20 tests assert every decision template keeps `decision`, `rationale`, and `confidence` blank or neutral, and that `official-blog:review-decisions` still requires a separate AI decisions file.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep future AI handoff automation from filling decision fields or promoting `needs_review` items before explicit normalization and human checkpoints.

suggestions.issue: The workflow still depends on an operator or agent to paste AI decisions back into the expected JSON shape.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 20 creates the prompt and blank decision template but intentionally does not call AI or populate decisions.
suggestions.suggestion: Consider a later validation-only sample decisions fixture or schema helper for operator-filled AI outputs.
suggestions.expected_benefit: A schema helper could catch malformed AI output before decision normalization without weakening the manual checkpoint.
suggestions.promotion_path: Future project iteration with tests proving malformed decisions are rejected and no AI output is auto-generated.
validation_evidence: official blog review-handoff CLI writes clean prompt and decision template

followups.action: Consider a validation-only helper for operator-filled AI decision JSON after handoff usage stabilizes.
